app.q: Do guests need to install an app?
app.a: No. They scan the table's QR code with their camera and the menu opens in the browser.

pay.q: Where does online payment money go?
pay.a: Straight to the hotel: you enter your own Zarinpal merchant ID in the settings.

cash.q: What if a guest wants to pay cash or by card?
cash.a: No problem: they request payment from the table and the waiter is notified.

hardware.a: No. A tablet or phone for the kitchen is enough; everything runs in the browser.

menu.a: Instant. Change a price, a photo or mark a dish sold out; guests see it right away.

offline.q: What if the Internet goes down?
offline.a: The Spotihotel desktop app runs on the restaurant's local network: orders, kitchen and printing carry on, and everything syncs when the Internet is back.

branches.q: I have several branches: can I see them all in one place?
branches.a: Yes. The group view shows sales for every branch, and you can copy a menu from one branch to another.

landing.finalBody: Set up rooms, rates and services, print the room QR codes and check in your first guest today.

footer.tagline: Front desk, bookings, room QR and hotel accounting in one platform.

app.q: Do guests need to install an app?
app.a: No. They scan their room's QR with the camera and the portal opens in the browser.

data.a: On servers in Iran, backed up every day; each hotel only sees its own data.

switch.q: How long does switching to Spotihotel take?
switch.a: A day for the essentials: rooms, rates and team. Future bookings are entered or imported next.

channels.q: What about bookings from the platforms?
channels.a: Each booking keeps its platform (Snapptrip, Alibaba, Jabama, Eghamat24…) and reference; the commission is booked when the guest leaves.

books.q: Does the accounting follow Iranian rules?
books.a: Yes: Iranian chart of accounts, fiscal year from Farvardin, seasonal VAT, Sayad cheques, export for your accountant.

chain.q: We have several hotels: is everything centralised?
chain.a: Yes. The group console shows each hotel's occupancy, ADR and RevPAR, central availability and consolidated accounts.

offline.a: The Spotihotel desktop app carries on over the hotel's local network, and everything syncs when the Internet is back.
